name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty in abeyance; no LoC strike found
summary: Pakistan presses the UN over India's Indus treaty suspension; troops fired near the LoC on 16 Nov
state: Pakistan has denounced India's holding of the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance at the UN as setting a precedent for resource-based coercion (Dawn). Indian troops opened fire after suspicious movement near the Line of Control in Poonch on 16 Nov; no casualties or exchange with Pakistani forces were reported (Telangana Today). No cross-border strike or mobilisation was found as of 21 Nov, so Watch holds on the treaty suspension.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for areas near the India–Pakistan border and Kashmir.
rubric_hit: Treaty suspension and LoC firing = Watch

sources.title: Dawn — Pakistan denounces India's suspension of IWT
Telangana Today — Army opens fire after suspicious movement near LoC in Poonch

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
